en: It only took hours and hours of navigating this city, but I made it!

ja: 準備はいい?

en: You said this isn't actually the building where the PULSE is?

ja: でもここがリボーン地方全体で唯一のデボンビルだって、100%確信してるのよ!

en: Not only did I have to stop and find a way to look it up, but when you took so long to get here, I even had to ask a filthy old man if I was in the wrong place!

en: So please, \PN, explain to me how it is that, after YOU told me to go to the Devon Building and then refused to come with me, leaving me to navigate for myself all alone in a completely unfamiliar region, now we are here and you are telling me that this is the WRONG BUILDING?!

key: Haha!
en: Haha!

en: Okay, have a great day, officer, bye!

en: I really will keep it.  You do want this Egg, yes?

ja: 誤解しないでくれよ、街が良くなったのはうれしいんだ。

ja: でもマジな話、前とは同じ感じがしないんだよな。

en: We used to own these streets. Now everything's wrapped up in order and perfection.

en: No thanks.
ja: 遠慮しとくよ。

en: There's more Pokémon here lately than I thought there could be in the entire city!
ja: 最近、街全体で想像してたよりずっと多くのポケモンがいるみたいだ!

en: Think I can catch 'em all?!

en: It's everyone's responsibility to keep this city clean.
ja: この街をきれいに保つのは、みんなの責任だ。

en: That's what Adrienn has demonstrated.
ja: アドリエンヌが示してくれたことだよ。

en: Lower class citizens deserve peace too!

en: Who wants to live in a tar-smellin' factory all day!?
ja: タールくさい工場で一日中暮らしたいやつなんかいるかよ!?

key: The administrative office will write it off in terms of priorities, but don't believe their lies!
en: The administrative office will write it off in terms of priorities, but don't believe their lies!

key: The people in charge do not care about you! The government does not care about you!
en: The people in charge do not care about you! The government does not care about you!

en: This city is so cool now, isn't it?
ja: この街、今すごくかっこいいよな?

key: It's like it keeps evolving!
en: It's like it keeps evolving!
ja: まるで進化し続けてるみたいだ!

en: My momma used to worry about me going out alone, but not anymore!
ja: ママは前、あたしが一人で出かけるのを心配してたけど、もうそんなことないの!

key: It's cuz I grew up, huh?
en: It's cuz I grew up, huh?
ja: あたしが大きくなったからだよね?

en: There's been so much to do lately! Commerce is really kicking up since the changes started coming in!
ja: 最近やることが多くてさ!変化が始まってから、商売もほんとに盛り上がってきてるんだ!

key: Gotta play the market to make a killing!
en: Gotta play the market to make a killing!

key: Hail, Trainer.
en: Hail, Trainer.
ja: やあ、トレーナー。

ja: 自警団はトラブルに目を光らせている。何か怪しいものを見かけたら、我々に報告してくれ。

en: "Madame Meganium's Magic Medicine Market"
ja: 「メガニウム夫人の魔法の薬市場」

en: Have you heard the rumours about Agate City?
ja: アゲートシティのうわさ、聞いたか?

key: Pretty crazy, right? Even if it's not true, it's interesting.
en: Pretty crazy, right? Even if it's not true, it's interesting.

key: Really?
en: Really?
ja: ほんとに?

key: They say it used to be part of a different region entirely.
en: They say it used to be part of a different region entirely.
ja: 昔は全く別の地方の一部だったらしいぞ。

key: And! I heard there's even a magic stone buried deep underneath it!
en: And! I heard there's even a magic stone buried deep underneath it!
ja: それに!地下深くに魔法の石が埋まってるって話も聞いたぞ!

key: If only something like that could exist here...
en: If only something like that could exist here...

en: AME: We're ready. Once you, Victoria and Arclight are in position, we'll head in there and draw their attention.
ja: アメ:準備はできてる。あんたとヴィクトリアとアークライトが配置についたら、私たちが乗り込んで注意を引くわ。

key: Devon's basement entrance should be somewhere in the Underground Railnet.
en: Devon's basement entrance should be somewhere in the Underground Railnet.
ja: デボンの地下入り口は、地下鉄道網のどこかにあるはずよ。

key: You can find it, right? The others are there waiting for you.
en: You can find it, right? The others are there waiting for you.
ja: 見つけられるでしょ?みんなあそこであんたを待ってる。

key: ADRIENN: Were you checking on us, \PN?
en: ADRIENN: Were you checking on us, \PN?
ja: アドリエンヌ:私たちの様子を見に来てくれたの、\PN?

key: Don't worry, we're going to be just fine.
en: Don't worry, we're going to be just fine.
ja: 心配しないで、私たちは大丈夫だから。

key: Head on down to the Railnet and we'll get started.
en: Head on down to the Railnet and we'll get started.
ja: 地下鉄道網に降りていって、始めましょう。

key: I think I really took this whole nature thing for granted before.
en: I think I really took this whole nature thing for granted before.
ja: 前は自然っていうものを、本当に当たり前だと思ってたんだと思う。

key: Now that I've seen what it's like to have a peaceful area in the city, I wanna protect it.

ja: 街の中に穏やかな場所があるのを見た今、それを守りたいと思うんだ。

key: But I don't think there's anything I can do...
en: But I don't think there's anything I can do...
ja: でも自分にできることなんてなさそうだけど……

key: Huh? They need help at Coral Gym?
en: Huh? They need help at Coral Gym?
ja: え?コーラルジムで人手が要るの?

key: Mm, I'm not sure if I'm the kind of help they're looking for, but I'll go check it out anyway!
en: Mm, I'm not sure if I'm the kind of help they're looking for, but I'll go check it out anyway!
ja: うーん、あたしが求められてる助けかはわからないけど、とにかく見に行ってみる!

key: Hello, sweetie!
en: Hello, sweetie!
ja: こんにちは、あなた!

en: Has your home already been renovated? If not, just tell one of the construction leaders, so it can be put on the queue!
ja: あなたのお家、もう改修は終わった?まだなら、工事責任者の誰かに伝えて、順番待ちに入れてもらってね!

en: Silph Co. has really bursted into business lately. Have you SEEN the stuff at the top of the department store?!
ja: シルフカンパニー、最近本当に商売が絶好調だよな。デパートの最上階のグッズ、見た?!

key: Hey, wow! Like, you would have never believed it, how everyone came together to make this place great!
en: Hey, wow! Like, you would have never believed it, how everyone came together to make this place great!

en: "Thank you", they command me to whisper, "for everything."

en: Honey, whatchu waitin' for?

key: Time for you to prove you're not a loser anymore~

key: Oh, hi there.
